title: Jev's pick needs a score floor before any spend
hypothesis: Jev's choice question alone picks the buyer.
change: Scored every candidate 0 to 2 with a rubric that ranks paid people lowest, and stopped under 0.5.
result: Jev's choice alone named a Celsius Mentor who scored 0.03 of 2. A 1.0 floor for the runner-up skipped a 0.76; 0.5 worked for both.
next_decision: Write the pick and its reason into a Why this person column on every row, stops included.
check: A model pick is a proxy: give it a score, a floor, and a written reason before a paid lookup runs on it.
